description:
Hello Plum AMOLED smartwatch with 2.1" full‑touch HD display is built for people who want a big, vivid screen and reliable daily health tracking in a stylish watch. The AMOLED panel pops with deep blacks and crisp text, so notifications, time, and workout stats stay easy to read—indoors or outdoors. Track heart rate, SpO2, steps, calories, and sleep to stay aware of your routine and recovery, whether you’re working, walking, or training.

With Bluetooth 5.1, it pairs smoothly with Android and iPhone for alerts and controls. IP68 water resistance means it can handle sweat, splashes, and daily wear without stress. Battery life is up to 2 days, making it a practical choice for busy schedules—charge, wear, repeat. If you want a premium-looking AMOLED fitness smartwatch that keeps you on time, on track, and connected, Hello Plum fits right in.

Sleep + activity tracking: Tracks sleep patterns, steps, and calories to help you build healthier routines.
Bluetooth 5.1 connectivity: Smooth pairing and stable connection for notifications and daily syncing with your phone.
Up to 2-day battery life: Designed for busy schedules—charge once and wear through work, workouts, and nights.
IP68 water resistance: Handles sweat, splashes, and daily wear with more confidence (avoid hot showers and deep swimming).
Custom watch faces: Switch looks quickly to match office wear, casual outfits, or gym sessions.
Simple, fast navigation: Intuitive interface for quick access to health stats, settings, and daily tools.
